title: Medieval
description: This modpack aims to make Minecraft into a medieval light-fantasy world.
body:
![Minecraft Medieval [1.0] Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bd6f855602f9764bd9ecf7a79992fe95ceb0ccf9.png)
___
This modpack makes minecraft into a **medieval light-fantasy** experience. Great for people who like a **cozy, adventourus, and chalenging** game! This modpack includes many things such as **wine** making, more **armour**, more **weapons** with **enhaced combat**, **skills**, **classes**, new **animals**, and more!
___
## Italation:
1. Install the modpack
2. Add [CosmeticArmorReworked](https://www.curseforge.com/projects/237307) by zlainsama
3. Add [Blood Red Sculk](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/blood-red-sculk) by KillzoneMF
4. Have fun!
